text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, a wide variety of spectators have flocked to Hanshin Racecourse to watch the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's already time for the racers who debuted this year to start dipping their toes into G1 races, huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: This is the race that will decide the junior champion. Now, which one of these racers has what it takes to secure their first G1 victory, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this place is like, mega crowded! It's like a festival up here!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't this actually a pretty crazy race? It's wild that Ines is competing in it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I didn't make it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to be in the center of all this excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer is recovering from her fracture, and McQueen still hasn't made her debut yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was the only one who could carry the Mejiro name and step up to the challenge…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was the most popular racer at first, and everyone had big expectations for me… But I lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If McQueen had made it in time, the result would have been different for sure. She would have put on a great performance worthy of the Mejiro name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I just can't seem to become a Mejiro Umamusume like her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan! I discovered some truly scrumptious ice cream. Let us share it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright?! When did you buy ice cream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bright?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness I caught you in time. You're not hurt, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine. But the ice cream… it spilled all over your legs…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about that! I'm just glad you're okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I guess all that training was good for something—I've got some explosive acceleration, at least!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Oh, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You have so much more than just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I've been watching you since we were children. You'd wake up at the crack of dawn and run laps around the Mejiro gardens.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You wanted to be the fastest, the strongest—so you tried to put in more effort than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I know, because you're the person I look up to the most.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …Thanks, I needed to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin is about to take on her first G1 race, the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look! It's amazing! They're airing a TV special about the Asahi Hai!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My sisters sent it to me! Look! You can even kind of make me out in the background if you look carefully!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Truthfully, Ines Fujin hasn't been able to practice as much as her peers, since she struggles to find time to train on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, this race is merely a stepping stone towards taking on the Derby. The primary goal is to help her gain experience in G1 races, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some, that first G1 race can be a soul-crushing experience that opens their eyes to the gap in skill compared to their opponents.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Hellooo?
choice_data_list: Um, right now you should take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, right…
choice_data_list: Focus on the experience rather than winning!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! I see! Hm, hmm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Ahaha! Say, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can tell exactly what you're thinking! You worry too much! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you keep making that face, you're gonna make me anxious, too. Is that what you want? Me being all shaky and nervous?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Exactly! So quit it with the worrying! C'mon, show me that fearless smile of yours!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You know, like, "This is my trainee, so she'll take first place for sure!"
choice_data_list: My trainee will take first place… for sure…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Good enough, I guess! Now I want you to grab a seat in those stands and keep that smug look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's time to show off my stuff!
